sentences.text: This appeal has been preferred under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act against the impugned award dated 16.01.2007 passed in Claim Case No. 62/2005 whereby survivors of the deceased Sardar have been awarded an amount of Rs.2,74,500/- along with interest.

0 2 . Learned counsel for the appellant/insurance company prays for setting aside the impugned award on the ground that the deceased was travelling in a tractor trolley and, therefore, insurance company is not liable for any type of responsibility for payment of compensation.
He prays for allowing the appeal by setting aside the impugned award.
03. Learned counsel for the respondents has opposed the prayer and prays for dismissal of the appeal.
0 4 . Heard and considered the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
From perusal of the evidence available on record and impugned award, principle of pay and recover has been applied which cannot be said to be unreasonable in the facts and circumstances of the case.
This Court is of the view that no case for interference is made out.
Accordingly, the present Miscellaneous Appeal is dismissed.
(BINOD KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE soumya The United India Insurance Co.Ltd. vs Kala Bai on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137404270/
